verify_hint: Check the detail-view field loop (`if (v == null || v === "") continue;`) and the groups-row comment near it in `src/sqllens/ui/memory_admin.html`
prior_evidence: memory_admin.html:995-996 loop skip rule is `if (v == null || v === "") continue;`. It hides null (and undefined, ""), so null is right. A blank [] is neither null nor "" (strict equality with ""), so it would NOT be skipped; it would render an empty-text row via String([]). The comment at 1014-1015 says the skip rule would hide blank [], which is false. The groups row is still correctly outside the loop (renderGroups at 624-636 gives distinct unreadable/untagged labels for null and []), and null would be hidden, so the placement rationale holds in part. The wording is inaccurate for [] (it would render as a blank value, not hide). This is a comment-only inaccuracy.
